title: Group words by stem
description: Lists the word types of the project's Texts that end or start in a string, or match a pattern, grouped by candidate stem, and marks each stem known, fitting or not fitting. It reads and never writes.
usage: Usage: motif group <suffix|prefix> --project <fwdata> (--ending <text> | --start <text> | --pattern <regex>) [--parse-state parsed|unparsed|approved|all] [--limit <1-200>] [--page <N>] [--min-stem <N>] [--fold <set>] [--as-of baseline|<proposalId>] [--format table|json] [--json]
